newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HOIUPANK MULLS MERGER, SAYS FOREKS INTERESTING.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HOIUPANK MULLS MERGER, SAYS FOREKS INTERESTING.

text.p: Hoiupank said on Tuesday it was interested in merging with a smaller local bank in order to gain some growth in market share.
"Hoiupank is interested in merge with any other of Estonia's commercial banks," Erkki Peegel, vice head of the press department, told Reuters.
"We ourselves have a bigger interest towards Forekspank as a very effective financial company," he added.
"Estonia's market is small and it is difficult to get new clients, so one of the easiest ways (to grow) would be to merge with a smaller bank," he said.
Hoiupank has received different merger and cooperation proposals from other commercial banks, Peegel said, but refused to give any names.
Peegel added that there have been no official negotiations between Hoiupank and other banks.
